# Travis Murdock

> Head of Go-To-Market at CopilotKit. Storyteller and Builder. Personal site and contact point.

This is a single-page personal site. The canonical (and currently only) page is the homepage.

## About

Travis Murdock is the Head of Go-To-Market at [CopilotKit](https://copilotkit.ai), the open-source framework engineers use to build in-app AI copilots and agents. He is also a lead mentor in the Techstars Seattle program. Based in the Greater Seattle Area.

## Areas of expertise

- AI copilots and agents
- Go-to-market strategy for developer-focused B2B software
- Founder-led sales
- Open source software
- Startup mentorship

## Site contents

- [Homepage](https://travismurdock.com/): Logo, short bio, social profiles, and contact email.
